descriptionEn: This batch calls k3.1-pro through Kimi Coding Plan’s native Anthropic Messages endpoint https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages. Each requested default/low/max configuration plans 23 tasks; at most three requests run concurrently, sequentially within each configuration. New dispatches stopped when the five-hour subscription quota was exhausted. Unsent tasks have no fabricated attempt, and quota failures are not scored as model-answer failures. The server accepted the invalid-effort negative control, so the effective low/max semantics are not independently confirmed.
